einzeiler: An investigative look into the rise, fall, and fierce battles of Miss America.
kurzfassung: The podcast explores the history and current crisis surrounding the Miss America organization. Former contestants and insiders share accounts of toxic leadership, bullying, and broken promises regarding scholarships. The series investigates the legal battles and internal conflicts threatening to destroy the iconic institution.
stichpunkte: Miss America was once a massive primetime television event drawing 80 million viewers.
The organization promoted women's empowerment and offered significant financial opportunities.
In recent years, the pageant has faced scandals, leaked vulgar emails, and lawsuits.
Leadership has been accused of controlling, manipulating, and bullying contestants.
Two rival parties are currently fighting over ownership of the organization.
Former winners report not receiving promised scholarship money for student loans.
Insiders describe body shaming, derogatory comments about contestants, and an eating disorder dismissal.
The podcast investigates the organization's attempts to interfere with the production.
